newsitem.title: UK: Three killed in British motorway pile-ups in fog.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in British motorway pile-ups in fog.

text.p: Three people were killed and 30 injured on Monday, half of them seriously, in British motorway pile-ups in thick fog during the morning rush hour.

At least 15 vehicles caught fire, including two lorries, when 60 vehicles collided on the M42 motorway near Birmingham, central England. Police said a petrol tanker carrying highly flammable benzine was close to the centre of the blaze.
Thirty minutes later another 30 vehicles collided on the same motorway. More than 100 firefighters were involved in rescue efforts.
